sections.title: Discourse Analysis II: Practicum
sections.description: This course provides a semester-long opportunity for students with some prior training in the theory, methods, and analyses of Discourse Analysis to develop their own empirical studies utilizing these approaches. While some initial review of discourse analytic tools will be provided, the majority of class meetings will be focused on student presentations of their own projects - including initial conceptualization, data identification and acquisition, theoretical frameworks, methods, and findings and analyses. Students will have several opportunities to workshop their projects with their classmates. This course is affiliated with COMM/SOCI 5400 Discourse Analysis I and is open to any student who has taken a version of that course or who (with the approval of the instructor) demonstrates the requisite foundational knowledge and training.
